title: People with striations
content: There's these people I've seen frequently in my dreams. By striations I mean their skin is flesh toned but mixed with red/orange patterns. They're normally ~7ft tall and look a lot like I do irl (light hair/light skin). They're kind. They pick on me for being small, but it's all in good spirit. There's one fella that really stands out to me, I think because he's my doppelganger. He's militant and takes command of his people. His leader is a dark haired guy, about 6'5, and he introduced himself to me as Lauren. He could be the General or something, I'm not sure. They're usually in dreams that feel like real life situations. Grocery shopping, parks, normal recreational stuff. Kinda like we're all just living a normal life. And these dreams take place in what I'm thinking is the same village. There's a quaint convenience store with ivy growing all over inside, and near the store on top of a hill is a watch tower. It's like a mix between the suburbs, an old-timey village, and the future. There's a park where they're playing maybe ultimate frisby, or maybe catch, who knows, but they always invite me to join. Sometimes I do, sometimes I just continue my walk through the park.
